rss: Flight chaos caused by 'millisecond' software defect, report says
title: Toy Planes Grounded by Glitch
story: A little glitch in the computer caused toy planes to stop flying for a day. Many kids had to wait to play with their favorite toys.
storyBig: A software defect caused a temporary halt in the availability of toy planes, affecting sales and customer satisfaction. This highlights the importance of robust software testing in the toy industry.
think: What would you do while waiting for your toy plane to work again?
bull: Fixing glitches makes toys better in the future.
bear: Glitches in toys can make people upset and lose interest.

rss: The virtual worlds where robots are trained
title: Robots Learn to Play Better
story: Robots are using make-believe worlds to practice their skills. This helps them do better things in the real world.
storyBig: Robots are now being trained in virtual environments to enhance their real-world capabilities, leading to more effective and sophisticated robotics solutions.
think: How would you teach a robot a new trick?
bull: Robots can become super helpers with more practice.
bear: Robots need a lot of training before they can be really helpful.
